title_how: Neutral gateways: satellite operators become tenants

flow.detail: Screen large tower parcels with land, permits, grid power, fiber and low RF interference for gateway use
Prepare pads, power, backup, cooling, security and fiber meet-me room for 6-20 antenna positions per site
Rent pads to multiple LEO and D2D operators on 10+ year contracts with escalators, like a tower lease
Sell power, cross-connects and remote hands; buy captive gateway networks via sale-leaseback

payers.pays_for: Antenna pad rent, power and fiber cross-connects at gateways (e.g., Amazon Leo, OneWeb)
Gateways near MNO core networks, plus colocation of 3GPP ground equipment
Interconnect and hosting of their D2D partner gateways next to their own sites
Shared antenna capacity and secure hosting for data downlink, often via GSaaS partners

title_market: LEO fleets need hundreds of new ground sites

stats.label: Ground stations Amazon Leo plans to install to connect its LEO constellation
Satellite ground station market by 2030, from US$ 41.0B in 2025; 15.1% CAGR, GSaaS fastest
SpaceX deal for EchoStar AWS-4/H-block spectrum to scale Starlink Direct to Cell

unit_economics.note: Illustrative: reuses owned land and permits; 10-15y contracts; ~10% unlevered yield at full tenancy; excludes antennas owned by operators.

title_plan: From anchor tenant to global gateway platform

precedents.name: American Tower - AST SpaceMobile
precedents.what: 2022 term sheet for AST gateway equipment on American Tower sites and data centers under a global master lease, plus managed services

precedents.name: Telstra - OneWeb teleports
precedents.what: Ten-year agreement for Telstra to build, host and run three OneWeb gateway teleports in Australia with 24/7 monitoring

precedents.name: KSAT and AWS Ground Station
precedents.what: Shared-antenna models: KSAT runs 260+ antennas at 26 sites; AWS rents antenna time per minute to many satellite operators

plan.milestones: Map 50 candidate sites in US, Brazil, Africa; sign one anchor LEO or D2D operator; build 2-3 pilot compounds
Second operator on same sites; standard master lease; 20+ compounds; first captive gateway sale-leaseback
60+ compounds across regions; GSaaS partnerships; bundle with edge data centers and fiber for backhaul

kpis: Antenna positions leased and tenants per compound
Revenue per compound and annual escalator
